marketing_description: The DeWALT 20V MAX* DCF964B cordless high‑torque impact wrench provides 1200 ft‑lb fastening and 1750 ft‑lb breakaway torque through a 3/4‑in square drive, with a speed range of 0‑1200 RPM across four selectable settings and up to 1890 ipm impact rate. Powered by a 20 V lithium‑ion battery and a DEWALT‑built brushless motor, it features a trigger switch with a 4‑mode push‑button for speed and application control, precision wrench control to prevent over‑tightening, and an LED work light for visibility, all housed in a black/yellow 8‑7/16 in package.
